subject.title: fix(whatsapp): add chunk-idle timeout to inbound media download

question: Should WhatsApp adopt an unconditional 30-second per-chunk idle cutoff that destroys the underlying media stream when no data arrives?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically sound, but choosing the timeout budget determines when a slow yet potentially recoverable inbound attachment becomes a delivery failure, and the repository has no WhatsApp-specific product contract establishing that threshold.

options.title: Confirm 30-second cutoff
options.body: Accept the bounded delivery failure in exchange for preventing an inbound worker from hanging indefinitely, then merge after exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Adjust the timeout policy
options.body: Choose a longer WhatsApp-specific budget or another owner-approved policy and update the focused proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Confirm 30-second cutoff
recommendation.body: Accept the bounded delivery failure in exchange for preventing an inbound worker from hanging indefinitely, then merge after exact-head checks pass.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most strongly connects mcaxtr to WhatsApp inbound media continuity, reconnect behavior, and live-socket ownership.
